create.name: Lalah Delia
create.bio:
Lalah Delia is a Los Angeles writer and spiritual teacher best known for the idea of vibrational living: paying close attention to the energy of your thoughts, habits, relationships and surroundings, and choosing what lifts you. Her own path came out of years of hardship, which she speaks about openly, and led her into study and certification in spirituality and wellbeing, mentoring from teachers in holistic living and metaphysics, and wisdom from elders in her own community. Her book Vibrate Higher Daily: Live Your Power, published by HarperOne in 2019, collects that approach into reflections, mantras and everyday practices.

She teaches mainly online through Vibrate Higher Daily School, a membership she founded with live Zoom gatherings twice a month, a library of classes, meditations, journal prompts and downloadable guides, and a shared community. For people who want closer support she runs a one-to-one mentorship for those she calls conduits, people answering a call to share their gifts. Her style is lyrical and spare, mixing prayerful language with practical self-care. On Insight Timer she offers guided meditations, energy resets, affirmations and short video talks, and she has appeared on many podcasts and in the wellness press.

books.title: Vibrate Higher Daily: Live Your Power
books.author: Lalah Delia
books.description: Her HarperOne book on living with awareness of energy and frequency in daily life. Short chapters, mantras and prompts help readers notice what lifts or drains them and make small, steady changes.

courses.title: Vibrate Higher Daily School membership
courses.description: Her online school, with two live Zoom gatherings each month, a growing library of classes, meditations and printable guides, and member question time. A lower donation-based rate ($15 USD a month) is offered to those on tight budgets.

courses.title: The VHD Mentorship + Guidance Program
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring with Lalah in one-month or three-month forms, with calls twice a month and a year of school membership included. It is aimed at people stepping into a calling to share their own gifts.

free_resources.title: Lalah Delia on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, energy-clearing resets, affirmations and short video talks, including readings from her book, all free to hear. A good first taste of her calm, unhurried voice.
